cohort: All cesarean sections performed at Edith Wolfson Medical Center, Holon, Israel, from 1997 to 2012
finding: The cesarean section rate gradually increased from 15.29% in 1997 to 21.10% in 2012, with the leading indication being previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was the leading indication for cesarean delivery, persistently increasing over the study period.
